title: fraxinus angustifolia var. rostrata
intro: Fraxinus angustifolia var. rostrata, commonly known as English Blue Ash, is a deciduous tree species within the genus Fraxinus, belonging to the Oleaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects, as well as its ability to alleviate inflammation and fever. The therapeutic actions of English Blue Ash are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Studies have demonstrated the potential health benefits of English Blue Ash, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiviral activity.
